summary: First iteration full-stack testing of ANCRID. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/logout/me/refresh), all 14 ANCRID endpoints, overview shape (9 ecosystem modules — 7 connected + 2 idle), network search/filter, PATCH identity persistence, signup duplicate handling, unauth guards. Frontend: All routes, sidebar nav, protected route redirect, login (prefilled creds), overview cards (ecosystem-status + 9 ecosystem-<CODE> tiles, passport-card, scores-card, ai-insights-card with 3 insights, recent-timeline-card), Connected Apps page (ecosystem-visual + 9 nodes + 9 cards), Network search 'Nia' returns Nia Okafor, Settings save, and Logout->/login all working. No page errors captured. httpOnly cookie auth (SameSite=None; Secure) confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~550 lines with large inline DEMO_* seed lists — consider extracting to /app/backend/seed_data.py for maintainability once real data is wired.
seed_admin only updates password when it changes; identity fields on the seeded doc are never re-seeded on subsequent starts — acceptable for demo but noted.

CORS uses single FRONTEND_URL env var; if not set, defaults to http://localhost:3000 which would block the preview domain. Currently working because backend is being reached and cookies flow — verify FRONTEND_URL env is correctly set to the preview URL in .env for production safety.
PATCH /api/ancrid/identity accepts arbitrary dict for social_links without schema validation — low risk since auth-gated, but consider tightening.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin. Signup test creates unique test_<ts>@ancr.io users each run (not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/ is pytest-based, covers all endpoints and Create→GET persistence for identity PATCH. Login is prefilled on the Login page so navigation from landing -> /login -> submit works without typing. All 9 ecosystem tiles present with codes ANCRA, ANCRLAB, ANCRSync, INHEIRA, Vaulta, Passport, ANCRLaunch, ANCRVIEW, ANCRWAV (last two idle).
